subject.title: Crons ejecutaron mensajes de WhatsApp a la 1 AM fuera de horario y no se podían detener

question: Should this issue be split into a schedule-activation replay fix plus a separate emergency outbound-stop/delete-aborts-active-runs product decision, or should one PR try to cover both?
rationale: Source inspection shows a concrete cron replay bug, but the requested stop/delete/emergency behavior changes operator control semantics across cron, tasks, gateway shutdown, and channel delivery, which automation cannot safely choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split Replay Fix And Emergency Semantics
options.body: Land or replace the activation-boundary PR for replay first, then separately specify cron remove, tasks cancel, gateway stop, and emergency outbound-stop behavior.

options.title: Broaden The Candidate Fix
options.body: Ask the candidate PR or a replacement to include both the activation boundary and a maintainer-approved stop/delete contract before closing this issue.

options.title: Scope To Replay Only
options.body: Close only the schedule-replay subset after it lands and require a new issue for emergency stop semantics.

recommendation.title: Split Replay Fix And Emergency Semantics
recommendation.body: Land or replace the activation-boundary PR for replay first, then separately specify cron remove, tasks cancel, gateway stop, and emergency outbound-stop behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored the candidate PR's migration/ownership commits and is closest in the inspected history to the unresolved persisted cron semantics.
